Meta discontinues AI image feature after privacy backlash

Meta has decided to discontinue its new AI image generation feature following widespread criticism over privacy concerns. The feature, which allowed users to alter images on public Instagram accounts, faced backlash from various groups, including Hollywood's SAG-AFTRA union. The company has also faced scrutiny from India's MeitY regarding a BBC report on child sexual abuse material ads on Instagram.
